description: This file is an implementation of the AdHocReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to query and retrieve ad-hoc query configurations from a database, including fetching all queries, active queries, and individual query details. It also contains an inner class AdHocMapper to map database rows to AdHocData objects.

classes.name: AdHocMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper inner class that maps a SQL ResultSet row to an AdHocData object, using database-specific SQL generator and support classes for data extraction.

methods.name: retrieveAllAdHocQuery
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all ad-hoc queries from the database, ordered by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllActiveAdHocQuery
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active ad-hoc queries from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single AdHocData object by its ID; throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveNewAdHocDetails
methods.description: Returns a template (default) AdHocData object with default values.
